purpose: Cloud task workspace capability probe; not a behavioral benchmark trial
observed_model_metadata: The first two tasks exposed no model metadata. The third task response reported GPT-5.6 Sol; reasoning effort was unavailable. Its submission requested GPT-6 Luna with high reasoning through CLI config overrides, so the requested model was not verified.

tasks.test_skip_reason: The repository had no Issue 24 protocol, target fixtures, gold inputs, or test files.

result: The two isolated A/B checkouts contained the candidate skill but lacked the benchmark harness and grading data. The separate superb-skills-eval task had generic comparison, controller and scorer tools but no Issue 24 protocol, target fixtures, gold or holdout inputs, or tests; it ran zero tests. A Cloud lookup for the current summerfield-ai-zoo repository returned 403 repo_not_accessible. The third task response reported GPT-5.6 Sol with reasoning effort unavailable despite CLI config overrides requesting GPT-6 Luna high. No behavioral trial or U2/U6 scoring was possible. These observations support only separation within the inspected task trees, not KTD10 or the Cloud VM isolation guarantee.
limitations: Path inspection is bounded evidence; it does not prove every Cloud service isolation guarantee.
No candidate behavior trial, model comparison, token or timing measurement, holdout run, backup-mode activation, or provider publication was performed.
The task results did not expose observed model and reasoning metadata.
YOLO behavior was not exercised. Official Codex CLI documentation states that YOLO bypasses Codex approvals and sandboxing and is intended only inside an externally hardened environment.

The codex cloud exec help exposes no model or reasoning-effort option. A task submitted with model and reasoning-effort config overrides reported GPT-5.6 Sol and no reasoning-effort value; do not count it as a GPT-6 Luna trial.
The available Cloud environments did not include the current summerfield-ai-zoo repository or the required Issue 24 benchmark inputs.
